name: What types of ceiling molding are available for installation?

mainEntity.name: What types of ceiling molding are available for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maine Results, Inc. offers installation for various types of ceiling molding, including crown molding, cove molding, and picture rail molding. Crown molding adds a decorative transition between walls and ceilings, while cove molding offers a softer, concave curve. Picture rail molding, typically placed lower on the wall, provides a way to hang artwork without damaging the wall. When choosing, consider the architectural style of your home and the ceiling height; more elaborate crown molding suits higher ceilings, while simpler designs work well in standard rooms.
acceptedAnswer.description: We install crown, cove, and picture rail molding. Crown molding creates a decorative wall-to-ceiling transition, while cove molding offers a softer curve. Picture rail allows art hanging without wall damage.
